title: Design System: Bitrate for Artists — Light

body.purpose: Manrope interface copy inherited from the light Pencil system.

display.purpose: Space Grotesk for large product statements only.

label.purpose: Action text inherited from shared light component masters.

narrative.overview: A bright production workspace with a soft paper canvas, cool technical surfaces, precise violet and cobalt signals, and workflow-specific music imagery. The .pen file remains the source of truth.
keyCharacteristics: Bright neutral structure with restrained violet actions.
Soft local elevation rather than heavy floating panels.
Status uses semantic tints, text, and icons.
Mobile preserves content and the next action.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal layers before shadow; reserve dark surfaces for media that benefits from focus.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Static designs define intent; keyboard, focus, contrast, motion, and responsive behavior require runtime verification.

dos: Reuse light variables, masters, and original brand assets.
Use quiet borders and tonal layers for hierarchy.
Keep one dominant action per decision context.
donts: Do not leave dark-theme surfaces in forms or tables.
Do not use heavy generic shadows or full purple content cards.
Do not present concepts or demo data as shipped behavior.
